long_biography.plain_text:
Matt Rockman came from a prominent Melbourne business family, but its property interests had collapsed by the time he began his own career. A conversation with his friend Paul Bassat drew him into a plan to move job advertisements from newspapers onto the internet. Rockman joined Paul and Andrew Bassat in founding SEEK and took charge of sales and marketing, persuading employers to try a service that was still unfamiliar to them. The company went public in 2005, establishing the financial base for his later work.

He stepped away from SEEK's day-to-day operations to spend more time with his young family, then turned to supporting other entrepreneurs. His investment work has included venture roles and backing technology start-ups, with a later preference for growth businesses. The story is neither a simple inheritance of the family property concern nor an entirely unassisted start: he built a distinct digital enterprise from a well-connected business background.
